Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses Tandem Affinity Purification (TAP) to identify interactors of Gemin5 variants. While the PRIDE metadata mentions 'Phosphorylation' in the title and keywords, the 'identifiedPTMStrings' explicitly states 'No PTMs are included in the dataset' and the search parameters only list standard Met oxidation and Cys carbamidomethylation, indicating this is an AP-MS study of phosphorylation mutants rather than a phosphoproteome enrichment study.

scope: The complexes associated to the TAP-tagged proteins were purified as described.
Briefly, the extract from the TEV protease digestion of the first IgG Sepharose (Cytiva) purification was subsequently subjected to a second calmodulin (Agilent Technologies) purification step.
Two independent biological replicates of TAP samples obtained for G5845-1508-R1016C-TAP, G5845-1508-D1019E-TAP, and G5845-1508-L1367P-TAP were applied onto a 10% SDS–PAGE gel.
The protein complexes associated to these fusion proteins were isolated using Tandem Affinity Purification.

Note: The PRIDE metadata provided refers to a different set of mutants (T897A/E) than the main text (R1016C, D1019E, L1367P); extraction is based on the primary publication text which describes the MS analysis of the clinical variants.
